title: Trade body flags online-offline price gap after ₹24,000 crore ecom sales
description:
The Confederation of West Bengal Trade Associations (CWBTA) on Monday expressed concern over the rising volume of online festive sales and the deep discounts offered by e-commerce platforms, saying the widening online-offline price gap was hurting traditional retailers.
E-commerce companies have reportedly clocked around Rs 24,000 crore in sales in the first two days of the festive season, it claimed.
The apex trade body said such a shift in consumer spending, coupled with aggressive price competition, was putting significant pressure on offline retailers and traditional markets.
CWBTA president Sushil Poddar said the issue was not the growth of e-commerce but the large difference in prices between online and offline sellers.
